title: The Matrix Multiplication Bound ω ≤ 9/4 over Associative Rings
description:
A Lean formalization of the matrix multiplication exponent bound ω(R) ≤ 9/4 for every associative unital ring R, including noncommutative rings. The stronger intermediate result bounds the exponent of exact integer coefficient tensor rank by 9/4. For every positive ε, the development proves the existence of correct arithmetic programs using at most C n^(9/4+ε) additions, subtractions and multiplications. The trivial ring is covered by an explicit zero-cost program; its real-valued exponent is zero by the unchanged infimum convention.

This software archive includes the Lean sources, accompanying paper, dependency pins and verification records. Compilation, axiom inspection, fresh-kernel replay of the six-claim dependency closure, and frozen-specification Comparator with all six bundled checkers passed locally. These checks are mechanical verification, not human peer review. No improved numerical exponent, exact O(n^(9/4)) endpoint, efficient uniform circuit generator or bit-complexity result is claimed.

The extension's proof development and manuscript are AI-generated with Codex under Sela Navot's human direction. Creator credit records that direction of the project; the included PDF has no author byline. OpenAI supplied the numerical bound, main proof architecture and arithmetic-program specification. This project builds on the earlier all-fields extension and adds integral tensor methods and the passage to all associative unital rings. Exact source provenance is recorded in UPSTREAM.md and docs/IMPORT-MANIFEST.json.

The project uses Apache-2.0. Five vendored fixed-point proof modules retain their separate MIT license at lean/FixedPointTheorems/LICENSE.txt.
